stories.title: The AI trade cracks: stocks have their worst day since April 2025
stories.summary: Two days after Democrats swept Congress, fears of a crackdown on AI data centers sent the Nasdaq down 5.5% and Nvidia down more than 9%. X coped with jokes, like Bryan Johnson bathing in a stock heatmap's red glow.

stories.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape
stories.summary: A Southwark Crown Court jury convicted Russell Brand of one rape and three sexual assaults, and he was remanded in custody. Sean Lock's old 8 Out of 10 Cats takedown of Brand went viral again.
